title: Calusa Nature Center Planetarium

services.name: General Admission
services.desc: Glorious sound and imagery await you, now in comfortable plush seating! Our 5.1 surround-sound system and amazing Digitarium Lambda Plus laser projection system put you right into the middle of the action, and our new 42-inch-legroom rocker-back velour seats let you enjoy the show in a new level of comfort. Admission to planetarium shows is included in the Calusa Nature Center and Planetarium ticket price and all public daytime planetarium shows are free to members. Our planetarium shows rotate monthly and an up-to-date schedule can be found here. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Choose from a variety of offerings for your field trips! There's something here for every group, from guided nature walks to private planetarium shows. Programs are recommended to meet your educational goals and interests. ​ Field trips are available Tuesday-Friday during normal operating hours (starting at 10:00 am and ending at 1:00pm) and must be booked at least 2 weeks in advance. Choose up to three 45-minute programs to create a visit tailored to your group’s educational goals and interests. Field trips cost $12 per child and $15 per adult.
